source_label: Authored tool content: fictional template counts, assumptions and method references for a Beta–Bernoulli multi-armed bandit planner
assumptions: This is a practitioner tool, not a dataset: the templates, assumptions and references are authored for this page and stored in raw.json.
Every populated template uses the same fictional counts (8/100, 12/100, 3/20) and is labelled as fictional on the page and in exported decks.
User experiments are stored only in the browser that created them; nothing is uploaded.
